Clients

sessiond provides session registration, tracking, and querying. Additional system integration is implemented by clients.

Known clients:

  • sessiond-hooks: launches and supervises per-user session hooks.
  • sessiond-backlight: controls backlight and LED brightness for active local sessions.
  • sessiond-uaccess: manages dynamic device access rules.
  • sessiond-power: handles authorized system power actions.
